name: tpl-existence-2-goal
task: Open the door. Pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(door_open) is redundant: hard Existence(target_picked_up) with hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) already forces the door to open. Remove Existence(door_open); keep the box goal and precedence clause.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says to open the door before picking up the box, but the clauses only require both events and allow the box to be picked up first. Add hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up).

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(target_picked_up) and Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) require the door to open before the box is picked up, but nothing requires opening the door. The task separately commands “Open the door.” Add a hard Existence(door_open); keep the pickup goal and precedence.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the clauses do not require opening the door. `Existence(target_picked_up)` and `Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up)` together require the box and make `door_open` occur first, but they do not make it a goal. Add a hard `Existence(door_open)`; the existing precedence already orders it before the box.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(target_picked_up) requires picking up the box, but the task also commands opening the door. The hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) only orders those events; it does not require door_open. Add a hard Existence(door_open).
NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence clauses require opening the door and picking up the box, matching both commands in the task.

texts: Pick up the box in the other room.
